question: A sample of paramagnetic salt contains $2.0 \times 10^{24}$ atomic dipoles, each of dipole moment $1.5 \times 10^{-23} \text{ J T}^{-1}$. The sample is placed in a homogeneous magnetic field of $0.64 \text{ T}$ and cooled to a temperature of $4.2 \text{ K}$. If the degree of magnetic saturation achieved is $15\%$, what is the total magnetic moment of the sample?
